# Google Routes (x402 only)

`POST <service_url>` at **0.015 USDC** with Google's own request shape:

```json
{"origin":{"address":"Berlin Hbf"},"destination":{"address":"Alexanderplatz, Berlin"},"travelMode":"TRANSIT"}
```

**Send `X-Goog-FieldMask`**, e.g. `routes.duration,routes.distanceMeters,routes.polyline.encodedPolyline`;
the Routes API answers 400 without one. `computeRouteMatrix` is not offered: it bills per
origin×destination element and has no safe flat price.
Reference: <https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/routes/compute_route_directions>.

For agents: quote with `buy_pay_quote`, pay with `buy_curl` and `maxAmount` from the quote
(atomic units), or `buy curl --max-amount 0.015` (whole tokens). Payment is irreversible.
